name: synthetic-week
title: A synthetic week
description: One week of hourly flows, pressures, hourly exit-point nominations and bookings generated from the network model, with an unplanned outage at Kollsnes, reduced capacity on Langeled, recurring H2S and CO2 excursions at four fields, pressure excursions at Draupner E, Kårstø and Dunkirk and a pigging programme on every trunk, export line and interconnector. Synthetic: use it to see how live operations look, not as a record of real flows.
source: Generated by nora.stream.synthesize from data/nodes.csv and data/pipelines.csv
